fidelity: F2a -- Centrifugal Compressor Physics-Lumped (head-flow curve + polytropic real-gas + plenum/thermal ODE)
source: Boyce (2012) Gas Turbine Engineering Handbook 4th ed., Ch.7 Centrifugal Compressors; Menon (2005) Gas Pipeline Hydraulics, CRC Press; GPSA Engineering Data Book (2004)

unit.name: Single-body pipeline centrifugal compressor with discharge plenum

U2_tip_speed.note: Impeller tip speed at rated (design) speed N_design; Boyce 2012 typical 250-350 m/s

head_coeff_psi0.note: Zero-flow head coefficient psi = g*H/U2^2 at shut-off; Boyce 2012 Fig 7

head_curve_slope_a.note: Dimensionless quadratic falloff coefficient of head vs flow coefficient phi

phi_design.note: Design flow coefficient phi = Q/(A2*U2); Boyce 2012 0.05-0.12 centrifugal (rated ~100 kg/s here)

phi_surge.note: Surge-limit flow coefficient (positive head-curve slope onset)

A2_eye_area.note: Effective impeller eye / reference flow area for phi definition

eta_mech.note: Mechanical / bearing-seal efficiency of the body

eta_driver.note: Gas-turbine driver thermal efficiency (shaft work / fuel LHV); Boyce 2012 simple-cycle

V_plenum.note: Discharge plenum / pipe segment volume for lumped pressure ODE

m_metal.note: Casing + gas thermal mass for discharge temperature ODE

T_ambient.note: Ambient temperature for casing heat loss

C_valve.note: Downstream throttle valve flow coefficient: m_out = C_valve*sqrt(P_disch-P_line); sized so plenum settles near PR*P_in at rated flow

gamma.note: cp/cv for NG at pipeline conditions; Menon 2005

cp.note: Constant-pressure specific heat of methane ~50 bar, 290 K; GPSA 2004

Z_inlet.note: Real-gas compressibility factor at suction (50 bar, 288 K) via Standing-Katz; Menon 2005

LHV.note: Natural-gas lower heating value (drives turbine fuel calc)
